items.statement: The actual centered Gaussian matrix sequence is measurable, jointly independent, integrable, mean zero and pointwise self-adjoint. Its cosine-weighted sequence has the same properties.

formulae.label: Public centered structure
formulae.tex: \begin{gathered}(Z_i)_{i=1}^{d}\ \text{independent},\qquad Z_i\ \text{measurable and Bochner integrable},\\ \mathbb E_\mu Z_i=0,\qquad Z_i(\omega)^\top=Z_i(\omega)\quad(1\le i\le d,\ \omega\in\Omega).\end{gathered}

assumptions: Let \(d,q\in\mathbb N\) satisfy \(2q+1<d\), and put \(r=q+1\). The case \(q=0\) is included.

Use \(\Omega=(\mathbb R^d)^r\) and \(\mu=\gamma_d^{\otimes r}\), where \(\gamma_d=N(0,I_d)\). The physical row \(\Phi_i=(\omega_{1,i},\ldots,\omega_{r,i})\) comes from these original Gaussian columns.

Put \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(t_i=(1,\sqrt2\cos\theta_i,\ldots,\sqrt2\cos(q\theta_i))\), and \(L=2r+3\log(1000d)\). For a Lean index \(j:\mathrm{Fin}\,d\), the corresponding source index is \(j.val+1\).

Define \(Y_i=d^{-1}(\Phi_i\Phi_i^\top\otimes t_it_i^\top)\mathbf1_{\{\|\Phi_i\|^2\le L\}}\), \(M_i=\int Y_i\,d\mu\), and \(Z_i=Y_i-M_i\). The cutoff is closed and specific to row \(i\); all integrals use the same original unconditional \(\mu\).

Matrices have the standard finite-coordinate Borel structure and real Euclidean operator norm topology. The local Lean measurable-space definition fixes this standard structure; it is not a caller-supplied assumption.

The only proposition input is \(2q+1<d\). Measurability, integrability, independence, actual centering and symmetry are proved internally. In the private consumer \(X_i=w_iZ_i\), \(w_i=\cos((2q+1)\theta_i)\) may be zero or negative.

obligations.label: Actual centered matrix structure with explicit analytic prerequisites.

bindings.boundary: Public P proves the five centered structural properties under the original Gaussian experiment. The complete private Tests consumer proves the corresponding five properties of the cosine-weighted family and uses every output of P; it receives no public API or separate canonical node credit. Independence is asserted for each indexed family separately. Matrix Bernstein tails, full Lemma4.4 and both main lower bounds, actual oracle/precision/TV/dimension-condition-number/worst-query-cap/expected-cost adapters, serialized main/site/source-index/globalgraph integration and purification remain separate obligations.

assumption_deltas.source: The two sequences consist of independent centered self-adjoint matrices.
assumption_deltas.lean: Each family separately satisfies joint independence and true integral-zero symmetry, with measurability and Bochner integrability proved explicitly. Standard Matrix Borel structure is definitionally fixed.
